entities.summary: Arab, a notable figure in the history of Tajikistan, associated with Arab Conquest and Samanid Golden Age (819–999). Preceded by Samanid Empire and Muslim. Their legacy influenced Rudaki, the 'father of Persian poetry,' composes at the Samanid court in Bukhara and Avicenna (Ibn Sina) born near Bukhara, later writes the Canon of Medicine.
